name: btczig-live
description: MEXC spot: 30d 1h history + live protobuf kline/trade feed, ZIG vs BTC side-by-side candlestick charts with normalized overlay

scripts.report: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/report?format=text').then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log).catch(()=>console.log('server not running - npm run docker:up'))"
scripts.docker:report: docker compose logs --no-log-prefix | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const i=s.lastIndexOf('==== ZIG vs BTC');console.log(i<0?'no report yet':s.slice(i))})"
